message.content: Driving from San Francisco to Los Angeles typically takes **about 5½‑to‑6½ hours** under normal conditions—roughly 380 mi at an average speed of 60–70 mph. In heavy rush hour or during construction you might see up to 8 hrs; if you’re cruising through scenic routes like Highway 101 or I‑80/US‑50, add another hour or two. Always check real‑time traffic before heading out!
